Short incident write-up: INC-4721 (Dec 18) — summary below and next steps.

- Timeline: 2027-12-18 03:12 UTC — 03:45 UTC — a cache stampede on the large-context routing layer caused transient 5xxs; automated fallback triggered but routing throttled lost some traffic.
- Root cause: a small set of model variants (8k context family) expired cache entries simultaneously after a deployment; concurrent cold-starts overloaded a subset of pods.
- Mitigation taken: increased pre-warming, adjusted cache TTLs, and added a rolling restart safety window to the deployment job.
- Action items for QBR: add a permanent pre-warm metric to the dashboard and a failure-mode slide describing fallback behavior.

Forwarded message: 
> From: Monitoring <monitoring@redwood.com>
> Date: 18 Dec 2027 03:18:02 UTC
> Subject: [ALERT] east-us1 routing: elevated 5xx rate
> 
> Peak 5xx rate observed at 03:21 UTC — autoscaler responded; incident closed by automated playbook at 03:47 UTC.

I'll prepare a 1-paragraph root-cause summary for inclusion in the QBR slide pack.

Mina
